The AI won't score the candidates - humans will be in the room to assess the candidates and see how well they deal with the simulated situations. However, until October 19th, you can save up to twenty percent on gift cards when you buy them through the Google Play store . There are a variety of discounts and retailers available, including 20 percent off $50 at Barnes and Noble , 20 percent off $100 at REI , and 10 percent off $100 at GameStop . You don’t need an Android phone or tablet to save, but you’ll need to sign up for a Google Play account if you don’t have one already. In addition to the gift cards, Google is offering discounts on subscriptions like Calm and DuoLingo , as well as bonuses on in-app purchases in games like Pokémo
